brand_identity.tagline: See the system. Find what matters.
brand_identity.core_philosophy: Human thinks. AI structures. Human decides.
brand_identity.visual_direction: Deep navy & near-black base with electric blue, cyan, and restrained violet accents. Premium, modern, editorial, calm, and thoughtful. Avoids cyberpunk, excessive neon, gaming UI, generic AI network slop, or giant card walls.
brand_identity.quote: The goal is not to remove uncertainty. It is to make uncertainty easier to reason with.

key_visual_concepts.concept_a: Evolved Ribbon 8 - Flowing infinity/8 geometric symbol representing the iterative Leverage 8 Method
key_visual_concepts.concept_d: Emerging Path - Layered light pathways cutting through complexity for Hero sections
key_visual_concepts.concept_c: Focused System - Constellation of nodes and causal loops with highlighted leverage points

leverage_8_method_steps.name: Locate the Challenge
leverage_8_method_steps.description: Define the bound problem, current state, and desired outcome without jumping to solutions.

leverage_8_method_steps.name: Examine Patterns
leverage_8_method_steps.description: Identify trends, recurring behaviors, and systemic shifts over time.

leverage_8_method_steps.name: View the System
leverage_8_method_steps.description: Map key entities, boundaries, feedback loops, and surrounding environmental influences.

leverage_8_method_steps.name: Expose Assumptions
leverage_8_method_steps.description: Surface hidden premises, mental models, and unverified beliefs.

leverage_8_method_steps.name: Reveal Relationships
leverage_8_method_steps.description: Trace causal pathways, dependencies, and unexpected side effects between components.

leverage_8_method_steps.name: Assess Leverage
leverage_8_method_steps.description: Locate high-impact intervention points where small force creates systemic shift.

leverage_8_method_steps.name: Generate Experiments
leverage_8_method_steps.description: Design low-cost, testable actions with clear learning metrics.

leverage_8_method_steps.name: Evaluate Learning
leverage_8_method_steps.description: Review outcomes, capture surprises, update systemic understanding, and refine strategy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure every page and workspace tab is fully functional and responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Implement mock auth state management (localStorage or Context) supporting Sign In / Sign Up (Email & Password + Google mock) and Seamless Sign Out.
Ensure AI Guide panel allows active user interaction: asking questions sequentially, offering 'Propose & Confirm' action cards that directly update the analysis workspace upon confirmation.
Add pre-populated realistic sample analyses (e.g. 'Enterprise Churn Reduction', 'Supply Chain Bottleneck in Q3', 'AI Feature Adoption Strategy') so users see immediate value.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, nav links, inputs, tabs, cards, confirm actions) following kebab-case naming.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.header_transparency: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdown menus. Use glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0F19]/80 or solid dark backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography_rules: Use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk for display headers, Plus Jakarta Sans or Inter for body. Do not default to plain Inter for large headings.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_contrast: Ensure hover states explicitly set high-contrast text colors to prevent dark-on-dark invisible text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_philosophy: Maintain generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) to create breathing room and an editorial, high-end visual tone.
